status: FROZEN BEFORE CODE AND REAL DATA TRAINING; DEV TRAIN-ONLY, NOT CLAIMED CONVERGED OR SCIENTIFIC PASS

original_dataset.class: independently sealed noncanonical historical Wikidata-derived mirror (NOT official canonical Wikidata5M benchmark)

heldout.formula: WSP103 full (subject,predicate) group SHA256 split low-5 digest bits zero, query 4096 lowest digest priority

strongest_predecessor.control: WSP105 subject-specific symbolic two-hop with frequency fallback, same subject–predicate masked DEV cohort

question: Does a conventional, subject-sensitive learned KG embedding trained on every available retained historical TRAIN edge improve retrieval on the same known frozen masked DEV queries and identical WSP104 64-candidate-per-predicate universe?

model.family: DistMult knowledge graph embedding / negative logistic sampling
model.entities: full ID mapping of every unique retained TRAIN Q-entity, no hashing or collision, unknown entity receives no rank
model.relation: full mapping of every retained TRAIN P-predicate, no hashing
model.initialization: np.random.Generator(PCG64(41061)) Gaussian sigma=0.1 entities; relation Gaussian around 1.0 sigma=0.02
model.negative_object_sampling: PCG64 uniform over mapped retained entities, source row neg may coincide with positive, no resampling
model.shuffle: PCG64 permutation of all retained TRAIN edge indices for each epoch
model.nonlinearity: binary negative sampling softplus; stable sigmoid clipped scores [-25,25]; cross-entropy reported per epoch
model.post_epoch_change: none, no early stopping, no hidden-label selection or tuning

scoring.candidates: exact WSP104 frozen relation-conditioned Misra–Gries top64 selected from retained TRAIN, reranked by DistMult score for each (s,p); retain same tie-break ascending QID
scoring.evaluation: masked group any-answer Hits@1, Hits@10, best-match MRR across all 4096
witnesses: exact train SHA, masked group SHA, WSP104 frequency baseline Hits@1=921 Hits@10=1853 and ranking SHA 4a4364b6...
scoring.unknown_subject_or_candidate: rank known candidates first by score, missing embeddings rank -infinity (ascending QID tie break)
scoring.untrained_negative: same seeded embeddings before any updates, evaluated on identical sample/candidates
scoring.diagnostics: epoch train logistic loss, trend, wall/cpu, training memory, full-process wall
scoring.scientific_status: DEV_TRAINING_PILOT: an epoch-limited conventional baseline, NOT fully converged/strongest or SCIENTIFIC_PASS

stop: Preserve negative/positive results exactly, do not tune split, epochs, seed, embedding capacity or scoring after observing real heldout DEV metrics. Do not label fully converged if fixed epochs don't demonstrate convergence; matched independent strong baselines and cold-transfer still required.
